segments.name: Optical Instruments
segments.description: Develops and manufactures advanced optical instruments, including custom medical devices for minimally invasive surgery and optical components for defense, aerospace and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: We have been a developer and manufacturer of advanced optical instruments since 1982, and we operate primarily in two key market segments: medical devices and advanced defense/aerospace products.

revenueModel.text: Medical device, defense/aerospace and industrial customers pay the company for manufactured optical systems and components and for engineering and product development services.
revenueModel.evidence: During the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, approximately 72% of our business was from systems manufacturing, 11% was from engineering services primarily relating to the design of medical device optical assemblies, 15% was from Ross Optical, and 2% from our micro-optics laboratory.
